title: Census Sync Failures
dataSources: Hightouch sync run events (`hightouch:sync`), Census sync history (`census:sync`), Segment/RudderStack destination delivery and error events, audience-refresh latency metrics via REST.
app: Hightouch / Census sync webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Segment/RudderStack delivery events via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=census:sync event=sync_run_completed
| stats count as syncs, sum(eval(status="failed")) as failures by sync_name, destination
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/syncs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Tracks Census reverse-ETL sync outcomes and ranks syncs by failure rate so activation pipelines into operational tools stay reliable.
value: Like any activation tool, a failed Census sync leaves downstream systems stale; failure-rate ranking targets the least reliable syncs.
implementation: Configure a Census webhook to HEC; schedule every 15 minutes; alert on failures for critical syncs.
visualization: Table by failure rate, timechart of sync failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the jobs that send data from your warehouse into business tools and flag failures so the data stays current.
